title: ElevenLabs Voice Resources
problem: Siumai's ElevenLabs provider can generate speech when users know a voice id, but it lacks provider-owned resource clients for listing and retrieving ElevenLabs voices.
gates: cargo nextest run -p siumai-provider-elevenlabs --features elevenlabs voices --no-fail-fast
cargo nextest run -p siumai --features elevenlabs elevenlabs_voice_resources --no-fail-fast
next_task: Add read-only ElevenLabs voice catalog resources under provider_ext::elevenlabs::resources.

continue_policy.notes: Continue with ELVR-020 while keeping scope limited to read-only voice list/get resources, public facade resources exports, and no-network tests. Split voice mutation, pronunciation dictionaries, live credential gates, and generic voice-management traits unless a narrow task is explicitly accepted.
